scope: Assigned story, character and modular asset raster concept boards. No gameplay code or 3D models.

records.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape five-chapter storyboard for an original small mobile sleep-linked game, 꿈손님 여관, world 여울밤. Concept board, not a rendered working game.
Input image: Image 1 is a character, color and mood REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve the three original character identities, but reduce its decorative detail to about 25 percent. Do not copy its busy multi-storey architecture or dense village.
Primary request: a polished cohesive five-panel narrative board on warm ivory, exactly FIVE generous panels with a clear left-to-right then next-row reading order, three panels on top and two slightly wider panels below. Each panel has one short Korean chapter heading and a simple low-poly matte 3D scene. Substantial ivory gutters; no paragraphs or UI.
Visual identity: 모루 is a tiny sage green and cream moss fox with simple triangular ears, dot eyes and precisely ONE wide short tail; 도담 is a tiny cream pebble turtle with one smooth plain slate-teal oval shell, stubby feet, dot eyes and absolutely no patterned shell; 루미 is a tiny cream bean-shaped lamp moth with warm amber broad rounded wings, tiny antennae and dot eyes. Very simple toy-like low-poly mobile models, no fingers, no fur, no clothes, no accessories. Same designs and proportions across all five scenes.
World: one modest inn by a moonlit shallow stream and rounded forest shapes; slate-teal roof, warm amber lamp, pale wood and soft cream fabric. One single ground-floor room whose footprint is six square cells arranged three columns and two rows; no extra floor, no sprawling city. Keep just a few simple objects.
Panel 1 heading exactly "첫 불빛": dusk, a tiny amber lamp turns on at the small inn door, 모루 approaches along a short path by the stream.
Panel 2 heading exactly "창가의 편지": same inn and round window, 도담 finds a single small folded letter on the windowsill, 모루 quietly nearby. The letter has no readable writing.
Panel 3 heading exactly "비 오는 밤": same inn on a rainy night, 루미 arrives under the roof eave while one spare simple sleeping place is made ready inside; inviting warm light, calm not sad.
Panel 4 heading exactly "서로 다른 자리": a clean cutaway of this single six-cell room, showing the three friends choosing different cozy places. Back row left-to-right: 모루, a one-cell moss privacy screen, 도담. Front row left-to-right: 루미, one small lamp, one flat warm slate stone. Exactly 3 by 2 cells, clearly six cells. No table or extra hidden floor cell.
Panel 5 heading exactly "같은 지붕": the three friends reunited together under the same modest repaired roof at gentle dawn, sharing a warm quiet moment, same small inn and stream. Only a modest repaired roof / one directional hooded lamp upgrade, no tall building or city.
Lighting: quiet blue night and restrained amber warmth, final gentle dawn. Models should read clearly as tiny mobile game figures, uncluttered simple large color regions, no illustrative microdetails.
Only the five exact Korean chapter headings as text. No numbering, logos, text inside scenes, subtitles, UI buttons or watermark. Original characters only, no resemblance to copyrighted franchise mascots.
records.inspection: Five chapter headings and six-cell arrangement correct. A circular table below the lamp violated the base prop constraint; corrected in a targeted follow-up.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original mobile game character model design sheet, landscape wide composition on completely clean warm ivory background.
Input image: Image 1 is a REFERENCE for the three original identities and colors only. Use only the bottom character strip as identity reference. Do NOT repeat the inn, world, backgrounds or illustrations.
Primary request: disciplined production-facing design sheet of THREE characters in three evenly spaced horizontal rows. Each row contains five separated orthographic views left-to-right: front, true side, back, awake three-quarter pose, curled sleeping pose. At the far right of each row show a SMALL approximately 64px dark silhouette inset. All views in a row must show the SAME character design and proportions. No environment and no ground tile. Make the characters extremely simple, only about 25% of the reference's surface detail, suitable for tiny mobile low-poly models. Smooth large matte color regions, no textures.
Row 1, heading exactly "모루": original moss fox, sage green simple round body, cream oval muzzle and chest, two large simple triangular ears, tiny black dot eyes. Precisely ONE broad short curved tail with a simple cream tip. Very short rounded feet, no fingers, no individual fur strands. Front/side/back must retain the same one tail. Sleeping pose curls into one compact bean with its one tail tucked along the body.
Row 2, heading exactly "도담": original pebble turtle, cream pebble head, simple cream body and four short rounded feet. Precisely one plain smooth slate-teal oval shell, with NO hexagon pattern, seams, spots or decorative markings. Tiny black dot eyes. Sleeping pose with head softly tucked and eyes closed, still same shell.
Row 3, heading exactly "루미": original lamp moth, cream bean body, broad rounded warm amber wings, tiny two simple antennae and black dot eyes. No separate fingers, no costume. Keep wing number and outline consistent among front side and back views: two upper broad wings and two smaller lower wing lobes. Sleeping pose with broad wings folded around the body like a simple amber cocoon, eyes closed.
Only these Korean words are printed: at top over columns "앞", "옆", "뒤", "깨어남", "잠듦", "실루엣"; row names "모루", "도담", "루미". No additional text, numbering, speech, ruler, technical claims or measurements. The tiny silhouettes are solid dark charcoal and show recognizable fox ears and single tail, turtle shell, and moth wings, respectively.
Composition: generous uniform gutters; neutral studio light; tiny soft contact shadow only under full character views. Keep all three rows equally sized, no overlaps. Original game mascots only; no copyrighted franchise characters. This is a 2D concept design sheet, not a claim of a finished mesh or rig.
records.inspection: Three characters, five poses and silhouettes present. One fox tail, plain turtle shell and amber moth wings maintained. Names and Korean column headings readable. The side views remain slightly three-quarter and the silhouette insets are concept previews rather than exact 64px production sprites.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: landscape modular environment and prop production concept sheet for original tiny mobile game 꿈손님 여관.
Input image: Image 1 is a REFERENCE for ivory/sage/cream/amber/slate-teal palette and cozy matte material identity only. Reduce object and texture detail to 25% of reference. Do not copy its intricate building or village.
Primary request: clean wide asset sheet on warm ivory, no characters. Orthographic isometric camera for EVERY model, exactly same 45-degree yaw and about 35-degree elevation, same light from upper left. Large separated models with no overlaps. Simple low-poly/mobile-friendly geometry, large solid colors, no tiny accessories, sparse surface detail.
Layout: three clear horizontal bands, aligned left to right. Simple restrained Korean labels, generous gutters. These are separated concept models, never an assembled busy town.
TOP BAND, heading "기본 자산":
1) left large empty inn room labeled "빈 여관 · 6칸". One ground floor with EXACTLY SIX equal square wood tiles, precisely THREE columns by TWO rows. All six tiles unobstructed and visibly countable. Two low perimeter walls, one simple circular window in back wall, open front. No props, no bed, no upper floor, no hidden tiles, no foreground step, no roof obscuring tiles.
2) one small freestanding sage moss privacy SCREEN on ONE square pale base tile labeled "이끼 가림막 · 1칸". An upright very simple smooth sage panel and two minimal wood supports. No leafy hedge texture or flower.
3) one small warm amber floor LAMP on ONE square base tile labeled "등불 · 1칸". Simple cream shade, short stem and small round flat foot; sits directly on tile. Absolutely NO table, stool, pedestal furniture or stack.
4) one plain flat softly rounded warm gray slate STONE on ONE square base tile labeled "온돌돌 · 1칸". Low solid slab, no bowl, no hole, no cushion, no patterns.
MIDDLE BAND, heading "고를 수 있는 업그레이드":
5) label "가림등 · 1칸": directional hooded amber lamp on one square base tile, a simple downward-facing opaque hood visibly directing warm light to one side. Short stand and flat foot, no table.
6) label "긴 온돌자리 · 2칸": one long low warm slate sleeping platform spanning EXACTLY TWO adjacent base tiles; clearly show the seam between the two tiles and no third tile.
BOTTOM BAND, heading "선택 환경 분기":
7) label "벽난로 · 2칸": one extremely simple slate fireplace shape with a warm amber opening, footprint two adjacent base tiles. No tools, logs or other loose accessories.
8) label "지붕 관측대": a detached simple small slate-teal rooftop platform with ONE simple telescope, few chunky shapes, no character, no garden, no railing decorations.
9) label "물정원": a detached small shallow blue stream tile with two large rounded stones and one simple sage plant; no waterfall, bridge, house, extra scenery.
At bottom right, three small simple material squares labeled "천", "나무", "돌": cream fabric, pale wood, matte slate. All are neutral, few large details.
ONLY text listed above. No captions, measurements, performance numbers, logos, buttons, watermark or claim of model readiness. Same visual language across all assets. Roof observatory, fireplace and watergarden are optional environment branches, visually separated from the basic six-cell kit. Original art.
records.inspection: Six-cell empty 3x2 kit is visible. Three base props each on one tile; no table below lamp, warm stone is a flat slab. Directional lamp one tile and long warmed platform two tiles shown. Fireplace, roof observatory and watergarden are separated under optional environment branch heading. Fabric/wood/slate swatches present. Camera and footprints are visual concepts, not metrically validated meshes.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: revised five-chapter storyboard for 꿈손님 여관.
Input images: Image 1 is the STORYBOARD EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is a reference for the simple correct modular props ONLY, particularly the lamp with a stem and its own flat foot directly on a tile.
Make one precise correction in Image 1: in the LOWER-LEFT panel titled "서로 다른 자리", remove the circular wooden TABLE / stool under the lamp in the front-row middle tile. Place a simple warm cream-shade lamp with a short stem and its own small flat circular FOOT directly on that tile, matching the standalone lamp shown in Image 2. There must be no table, no legs, no stool and no additional furniture below or beside the lamp. Keep the front-middle floor tile fully intact.
Keep absolutely everything else in Image 1 unchanged: all five panels, framing, all Korean headings and their typography, character identities and poses, one single fox tail, turtle plain shell, moth wings, lighting, colors, stream, modest inn, six-cell grid and the other five cell contents.
Lower-left grid remains exactly THREE columns by TWO rows: back row 모루 / 이끼 가림막 / 도담, front row 루미 / 등불 / 온돌돌. Do not change the grid or add any seventh cell. No new text. This is a static concept storyboard.
records.inspection: Lamp table removed; lamp now has its own small flat foot directly on front-center tile. Five chapter headings and three-character identities retained. Six-cell 3x2 arrangement is correct. Environmental vegetation and lighting remain more detailed than the intended minimal mobile asset target; use this board as narrative mood reference and the modular board for production simplification. Relative 25 percent detail target is qualitative, not measurable from raster output.
